professional_summary.text: Backend Software Engineer with over four years of experience developing scalable backend applications using Python, FastAPI, and Django. Skilled in designing REST APIs, microservices, relational databases, cloud deployment, CI/CD, and software engineering best practices. Strong experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, RabbitMQ, AWS, Git, Linux, and performance optimization.

experience.description: Designed and developed scalable REST APIs using FastAPI. Built microservices deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. Optimized PostgreSQL queries, implemented Redis caching and RabbitMQ messaging, improved API performance by 40%, wrote unit tests, maintained CI/CD pipelines, and participated in Agile code reviews.

Developed backend services using Django and Python. Designed REST APIs, implemented authentication and authorization, collaborated with frontend developers and QA engineers, optimized SQL queries, maintained Linux servers, and resolved production issues.
